question: Whom does the sacred Śāṅkarī power or river save, including immovable beings?
premises: All beings are the object of saving.
The saving power is invoked as Śāṅkarī.
inference: O Śāṅkarī, may she save all beings, including the immovable ones.
uncertainties: Śāṅkarī may refer to the goddess or to the river as her manifestation.
plain_english: O Śāṅkarī, may you save all beings, even the immovable ones.
